subject: Clarify SOC 2 report inclusivity and point-in-time cutoff for procurement
messages:
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenfieldhealth.org>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Dawson <sarah.dawson@auditpartner.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 report - exact inclusive months and point-in-time cutoff

Hi Kimberly / Monica,

We're finalizing Greenfield Health's purchase review and our procurement team needs a small clarification on the SOC 2 Type II report you referenced. The report period listed on the cover is "July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026." Could you confirm whether: 

- The period is inclusive of both July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026 (i.e., the controls cover activity through 23:59:59 on June 30 UTC)?
- The point-in-time snapshot for configuration/point checks is the end-of-day June 30, 2026, or is it interpreted as July 1, 2026 (start of day)?

Procurement also needs to know if there is an available bridge letter covering the period after June 30 in case the contract start shifts into Q3. If so, can you attach a sample or outline the coverage and limitations?

We're trying to avoid requiring an additional attest if the cutover falls in early July. Appreciate a brief confirmation we can include in our packet.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reed
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenfield Health

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenfieldhealth.org>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report - exact inclusive months and point-in-time cutoff

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear questions. Tagging Evelyn from our security/compliance team to confirm, but for procurement purposes our standard interpretation is: 

- Reporting period on the SOC 2 Type II is inclusive (July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026), with point-in-time checks considered as of 23:59:59 UTC on the final day (June 30).

However, I want to confirm whether Greenfield interprets "point-in-time" as an environment snapshot timestamp or as the date used for exception testing; Evelyn can confirm the precise language we include in the report.

On bridge letters: we can provide a limited-scope bridge letter (typically covers the delta between the report cutoff and a new attestation, e.g., July 1–Sept 30). Evelyn, can you confirm the standard window and what we can reasonably warrant in writing?

If it's helpful, I can attach the full Type II PDF and a sample bridge letter once we confirm.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenfieldhealth.org>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report - exact inclusive months and point-in-time cutoff

Hi Tom — happy to clarify. Short answers up front: yes, the period is inclusive of June 30, 2026, and our point-in-time assertions reference the end of that day (we use 23:59:59 UTC unless customers specify a different timezone).

A bit more detail so procurement has language to copy into the packet: 
- Report period: "July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 (inclusive)." This means control testing and representative samples cover activity up to and including June 30, 2026.
- Point-in-time: configuration snapshots and point checks are recorded as of the last business second of June 30, 2026 (23:59:59 UTC). If your team requires a different cutoff (for example, local time for your corporate HQ), let us know and we can provide a written note of the timezone applied.
- Bridge letters: we can provide a bridge letter that covers an interim period after the report cutoff (commonly a three-month window). The bridge letter is limited: it states that there were no material changes in the control environment during the covered window to the best of our knowledge, but it is not a full re-performance. If you need an extended or attested window, we can discuss timing for an updated review.

I've attached the SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF (SOC2_Report_2026_TypeII.pdf) and a sample bridge letter (Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx) for your legal/procurement team to review.

Let me know if you need a one-line statement confirming UTC cutoff for the procurement packet and I'll provide it on company letterhead.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_Report_2026_TypeII.pdf (PDF, 1 file)
             Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx (DOCX, 1 file)

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenfieldhealth.org>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Dawson <sarah.dawson@auditpartner.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:47:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 report - exact inclusive months and point-in-time cutoff

Evelyn / Kimberly — thanks, that helps a lot. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Could you provide that one-line UTC cutoff statement on Redwood letterhead (we'll insert it in the procurement packet exactly as written)? Example we had in mind: "Redwood Inference confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report period July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026 is inclusive, and point-in-time assertions reference 23:59:59 UTC on June 30, 2026."

2) For our audit team (copied), can you confirm the exact report file version or identifier you have for the attached PDF so we can tie it to the vendor record (file name or internal reference is fine).

If you can send both items today it would close our procurement queue.

Appreciate it,
Tom
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenfield Health
Attachment: Greenfield_PO_8765.pdf (referenced)
